title: AccessController.doPrivileged dispatches the action (libcore)
statement: doPrivileged(PrivilegedAction/PrivilegedExceptionAction) executes action.run() and returns its result. The prior silent stub answered the typed default (null) without dispatching run(), so protobuf UnsafeUtil init stored a null Unsafe (F-152: Llt0;.w pc=808 objectFieldOffset on null receiver).
